scope: Every capability SpaceAgriSim claims or is asked about, matched against the data that would actually be needed to support it. A gap here is a statement about evidence, not a to-do list: several will stay open on purpose because the data does not exist at any price.

gaps.capability: Predicted crop water use in litres per plant per day
gaps.needed: Measured evapotranspiration or sap-flow/lysimeter water use for the modelled crops at plant scale
gaps.available: Reference ET0 computed from reanalysis (FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, cross-validated against four sources), a learned emulator of that computed quantity, an 18-check ingestion validator, and — new in Phase 26 — one third-party measured dataset: gravimetric per-pot evapotranspiration of greenhouse lettuce (Schröder et al. 2021, 35 published pots, 380 usable pot-days), acquired, hashed and preprocessed in-repo with an out-of-sample comparison against the platform's water path.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: A lysimeter or gravimetric water-use trial in the target growth system. No open dataset measures per-plant water use in a controlled-environment facility for lettuce or mizuna; this is a measurement to commission, not a download. New ingestion apparatus does not change the status: a validator can reject a bad measurement, it cannot create one.
gaps.currentStatus: open and blocking on its original terms, with its first measured evidence bench. The comparison artefact (ml/evaluation/phase26_measured_et_validation.json) shows the seasonal shape is broadly right (Spearman 0.7909 across 11 measurement days) while the level cannot be identified: on a pot-surface denominator the platform's flux is 0.247x the measurement, on a canopy-area denominator it is 2.7x. Because the study publishes neither pot diameter nor spacing, the sign of the discrepancy depends on an assumption, and no constant was changed.
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

stillBlockedBy: evapotranspiration includes substrate evaporation; transpiration is not separated
no per-day trial weather, so no reference ET0 and no crop coefficient
one cultivar, one greenhouse, four weeks, pot culture
evidenceAdded.closedGap: the 'no measured crop water use of any kind exists' clause only

gaps.capability: The claim that the ET0 target is itself correct
gaps.needed: A weather or ET0 source that does not share MERRA-2 lineage with POWER, and a measured latent-heat series to convert mutual agreement into physical truth
gaps.available: Four legs over 2021-2023 at six sites (6570 site-days): ERA5 0.25 deg hourly and daily, NASA POWER daily, ERA5-Land 0.1 deg temperature, and NOAA ISD station temperatures. Our FAO-56 implementation agrees with the provider's independent implementation on identical ERA5 forcing to bias +0.009 mm/d (MAE 0.181, R2 0.987), while the forcing difference between ERA5 and POWER is MAE 0.519 mm/d. The station leg is temperature-only (Hargreaves) and no leg measures latent heat.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Still needs (a) a Copernicus CDS token for the ERA5-Land hourly radiation and wind fields, which the credential-free delivery does not expose, and (b) a measured latent-heat series (eddy covariance or lysimeter) at at least one site, because reanalyses agreeing cannot establish absolute correctness.
gaps.currentStatus: open, partially addressed: disagreement now decomposed into formulation (0.273 mm/d), forcing (0.519) and implementation (+0.009) - the residual is weather, not code - but every leg is either a reanalysis or a temperature-only point method, so nothing here is field validation of the ET0 magnitude
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.capability: Effect of Mars or lunar gravity on crop growth
gaps.needed: Yield or growth measurements at gravity levels other than 1 g, with the same cultivar and protocol as the terrestrial baseline
gaps.available: Terrestrial controlled-environment trials only (one 6-observation lettuce study, one OSDR study with harvest mass)
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: None available. Orbital and Mars-surface experiments produce too few replicates and too few cultivars to fit a response function; the honest position is that gravity response is a qualitative modifier with a stated uncertainty, never a trained coefficient.
gaps.currentStatus: closed by decision, not by data: Phase 30 removed the fractional-gravity input, factor, control, API field and tests. The gap is permanent - no open dataset measures crop yield or biomass across fractional gravity, ISS graded-gravity work measures gene expression and morphology, and a ground clinostat or reorientation is not partial gravity - so the capability was withdrawn rather than left as a placeholder coefficient.
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

phase30Decision.what: the 15 %-at-0 g growth penalty, the gravity input field, the gravity presets, the gravity impact step and every test that asserted them
searched: NASA OSDR / GeneLab plant experiments with graded gravity (OSD-314, OSD-436, OSD-7, OSD-120, OSD-411)
NASA LSDA, NTRS, ESA and JAXA microgravity plant literature
Zenodo, Dryad, Figshare, PANGAEA, Harvard Dataverse, Mendeley Data for fractional-gravity plant yield
phase30Decision.whyRemoved: Every recovered record measures molecular, metabolic or morphological response, not edible yield per unit area at two or more gravity levels with the same cultivar and protocol. Nothing could calibrate a yield coefficient.
phase30Decision.residualCapability: None. /api/simulate rejects a request carrying a gravity field and names this decision; the simulator has no gravity term at all.

gaps.capability: Response to specific LED spectra and photoperiods
gaps.needed: Biomass or yield response surfaces across spectra, PPFD and photoperiod for each supported crop
gaps.available: The evidence base is one crop (lettuce) and one dedicated spectral trial. Phase 26 added a hydroponic spectral-composition trial (Zenodo 20394352, 252 plants across four fixed spectra at constant PPFD and 16 h photoperiod); Phase 29 rebuilt it into data/processed/phase29 and serves it as the measured light-stress workflow, which reports group means with bootstrap intervals, within-experiment tests and verified provenance. It remains a comparison of four named regimes, not a response surface: two regimes hold a fixed spectrum and one of those is the control, and one regime changes density as well.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: The published CEA literature is large but fragmented: hundreds of small papers, no shared protocol, rarely any raw data. A meta-analysis with study-level random effects is the realistic route, and it needs a person reading papers, not an API.
gaps.currentStatus: open for the predictive surface, served for two measured comparisons: the light-stress workflow compares four spectral regimes at one PPFD and photoperiod, and Phase 30 added a controlled-environment panel over the wheat series (PPFD, photoperiod, CO2, air temperature bands with measured grain yield). A response surface was fitted to that series and failed its sealed holdout (297.46 % MAPE against the 30 % criterion), so no predictive light, CO2 or temperature control is offered.
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

evidenceAdded.note: a measured comparison is now a delivered workflow; a response surface is not, and cannot be fitted from four regimes of which only two hold a fixed spectrum. The photoperiod half of the gap still has no dataset at all.

phase30Decision.decision: A (evidence found) for the measured comparison, B (removed) for the predictive response surface
phase30Decision.what: added GET/POST /api/workflows/light-stress/controlled-environment; the attempted response surface is recorded in ml/evaluation/phase30_cea_wheat_response.json and is not served
searched: Zenodo 17764612 indoor wheat, fully controlled environment (acquired)
Zenodo 8410252, 20759414, 22004997, 17712088, 22280237, 14529253 screened and rejected (licence, scope, simulation output, or no yield response)
phase30Decision.whyRemoved: The fitted surface missed the 30 % criterion by an order of magnitude on six experiments sealed before scoring; a served surface would have been an extrapolation with a decimal point.
phase30Decision.residualCapability: Measured band summaries with between-experiment intervals, a descriptive DLI association, and no significance test across bands.

gaps.capability: Root-zone water status in a hydroponic or substrate system
gaps.needed: Substrate water content, irrigation schedule and drainage fraction at high temporal resolution
gaps.available: None. SMAP L4 gives 9 km root-zone soil moisture for open fields, which is a different system at a different scale.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Instrument the target system; there is no open dataset. SMAP would only be relevant if the platform modelled an open-field deployment.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the simulator models a water balance from demand, not from substrate state, and says so
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.needed: Hourly temperature, humidity and radiation at the site
gaps.available: POWER daily aggregates. Daily Tmax/Tmin hides the duration and timing of an excursion.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: POWER hourly endpoint (same API, same access) or ERA5-Land hourly. Partly closable today, but the ET0 validation in this phase deliberately stayed daily to match the reference formulation.
gaps.currentStatus: open; no heat-stress claim is made that depends on intra-day timing
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.needed: Cultivar identity and calibrated growth parameters per cultivar
gaps.available: A single parameter set per crop, with no cultivar dimension anywhere in the data
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Cultivar trials in the target system. Breeder or seed-company data would be the natural source and is commercially restricted in practice.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the product exposes one parameter set per crop and does not offer a cultivar selector
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.capability: Plant health or growth stage from imagery
gaps.needed: Labelled canopy imagery from the platform's own camera geometry
gaps.available: None in the repository. GWHD (wheat head detection) and PlantVillage (lab leaf disease) exist but describe different crops, different sensors and different tasks.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: No imaging pipeline exists, so nothing is blocked today. If one is added, GWHD is the right labelled source for detection and PlantVillage is the wrong one for anything field-realistic.
gaps.currentStatus: open and deliberately not addressed; recorded so a future contributor does not train a lab-disease classifier and call it a capability
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.needed: Measured harvest mass with the same covariates the model uses
gaps.available: A small internal table plus six published lettuce observations used for external validation
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: More measured harvests with recorded light, temperature and duration. Until then the model's MAPE (41.7 %) is the honest number and the acceptance criterion is not met.
gaps.currentStatus: closed by decision, not by data: Phase 30 removed operational harvest forecasting. A leave-one-study-out evaluation over 40 published lettuce studies returned 310.17 % MAPE against the unchanged 30 % criterion, and the best out-of-fold candidate was the mean baseline, so no model in this repository can forecast harvest mass. The measured-versus-model parity record is retained; no prediction is served.
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

evidenceAdded.note: per-plant harvest mass now exists for lettuce in two independent experiments and tomato in one open-field experiment. None of them is a controlled-environment tomato or a mizuna experiment, and none is a spaceflight label.

phase30Decision.what: POST /api/workflows/harvest-prediction/run (now 410), the workflow catalogue entry (now status unavailable), the harvest UI tab, and every test that asserted a served prediction
searched: Zenodo 14640245 lettuce light-use-efficiency compilation (acquired, 53 treatment means / 40 studies)
Dryad, Figshare, PANGAEA, Harvard Dataverse, USDA Ag Data Commons, OpenAIRE for multi-study lettuce harvest datasets
phase30Decision.whyRemoved: The criterion was not met on any valid, leakage-free evaluation, and the candidate class could not express the between-study variation. A forecast that misses by a factor of ten is not a forecast.
phase30Decision.residualCapability: Measured-versus-predicted parity (GET .../parity) and the decision record (GET .../capability) remain readable.

gaps.needed: Downscaled climate projections at the candidate sites
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 is the standard product and is open; it was outside this phase's scope because the reference ET0 study needed observed weather, not projections.

gaps.capability: Yield loss from crop water deficit (crop-specific Ky)
gaps.needed: Measured yield at two or more water-supply levels for the same crop and cultivar, with enough levels to fit a Ky slope and an independent study to validate it
gaps.available: FAO-56 tabulated Ky values exist for many field crops but not for the three crops served here, and no open dataset recovered in Phase 30 measures lettuce, tomato or radish yield across irrigation levels. Two candidate sources were screened and rejected: a China remote-sensing yield/water-productivity dataset (no deficit treatment) and a mandarin regulated-deficit-irrigation trial (wrong species, no Ky).
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: A controlled deficit-irrigation experiment per crop with at least four water levels and a measured harvest. Ky must never be transferred between crops, so one experiment closes one cell of the matrix.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the FAO-56 water balance and the irrigation schedule remain, and no yield-loss claim is made anywhere in the platform
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

phase30Decision.what: no deficit-yield model was built and no Ky value is exposed; the water workflow continues to report demand, deficit and irrigation scheduling only
searched: Zenodo 5797817 (China RS yield and water productivity) - no deficit treatment
Dryad 7895889 (Diverfarming mandarin RDI) - wrong species, no Ky
Zenodo 73n5tb3d4 / gqnk98skd (Dryad) - imagery and a crossed faba-bean design
PANGAEA, Harvard Dataverse, USDA Ag Data Commons for lettuce deficit-irrigation yield
phase30Decision.whyRemoved: Nothing recovered pairs a water-supply gradient with a measured harvest for a supported crop, and transferring a Ky across crops is exactly the silent assumption the brief forbids.
phase30Decision.residualCapability: Reference ET0, crop demand, deficit accounting and irrigation scheduling, all labelled as computed rather than measured.

gaps.capability: Calibrated prediction intervals with measured coverage
gaps.needed: Enough independent evaluation points to estimate coverage per crop and per experiment group without reusing the selection data
gaps.available: The two Phase 30 evaluations produce intervals, but with 6 and 8 independent holdout points: a coverage estimate from eight points has a binomial half-width of roughly +/-0.3, so it cannot support a coverage guarantee.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: More independent experiments, or an external evaluation set with documented protocol. Neither exists for the crops served here.
gaps.currentStatus: open; intervals are reported as descriptive and no coverage is advertised. The removed harvest workflow's interval spanned a factor of 29, which is a measured statement about how little the data supports.
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

phase30Decision.what: train/selection/holdout separation was enforced and recorded in both Phase 30 artifacts; the harvest workflow was removed rather than given a wider interval
searched: no additional independent controlled-environment dataset was recoverable
phase30Decision.whyRemoved: n/a - the interval machinery is retained only where a measured comparison needs a between-experiment interval, never as a forecast guarantee
phase30Decision.residualCapability: Descriptive intervals on measured group means.
